name: a retry change accounts for the relevant prior latency failure
why: History matters only when it is relevant to this deployment. A previous retry-related latency failure justifies a slower configured lane without turning history into an automatic veto.

observations.statement: This release changes ledger retries, and a previous related release raised latency.

history_findings.statement: A previous ledger retry release failed after latency increased.

hazards.name: retry amplification
hazards.consequence: Request latency and load can rise together.

coverage.explanation: Request failures are measured, but latency is not.

assessment.rationale: The related failure supports a slower rollout while the configured health check watches request success.
